sort.description: A field name to sort by.

get_ticket_message.description: Get one TicketMessage record by its id. Fields: id, ticketId, authorKind, authorId, body, createdAt. ticketId is the id of a ticket (its name comes back as ticketIdLabel).

get_refund.description: Get one Refund record by its id. assign_ticket.description: Assign a ticket to a member of staff. Rules the app enforces: A ticket can only be resolved together with a resolution note. An urgent ticket that is still open is escalated automatically every hour.

ticket.description: The ticket, as {"id": "<its id>"}. Look the id up first with a list tool.

assignee.description: The user, as {"id": "<its id>"}. Look the id up first with a list tool.

reply_to_ticket.description: Reply to the customer on a ticket; the reply is saved as a permanent message and the ticket waits on the customer. Rules the app enforces: A ticket message, once saved, is permanent and cannot be edited or deleted by anyone. A ticket can only be resolved together with a resolution note. An urgent ticket that is still open is escalated automatically every hour.

ticket.description: The ticket, as {"id": "<its id>"}. Look the id up first with a list tool.

body.description: The reply to send to the customer.

escalate_ticket.description: Escalate a ticket with a reason; it becomes urgent and the reason is recorded in the conversation. Rules the app enforces: A ticket message, once saved, is permanent and cannot be edited or deleted by anyone. A ticket can only be resolved together with a resolution note. An urgent ticket that is still open is escalated automatically every hour.

ticket.description: The ticket, as {"id": "<its id>"}. Look the id up first with a list tool.

reason.description: Why the ticket needs a manager's attention.

resolve_ticket.description: Resolve a ticket with a resolution note that is added to the conversation. Rules the app enforces: A ticket message, once saved, is permanent and cannot be edited or deleted by anyone. A ticket can only be resolved together with a resolution note. An urgent ticket that is still open is escalated automatically every hour.

ticket.description: The ticket, as {"id": "<its id>"}. Look the id up first with a list tool.

resolution.description: What was done to resolve it; this is added to the conversation.

request_refund.description: Request a refund against an order for a ticket; the amount cannot exceed the order total, and a manager decides. Rules the app enforces: Only a manager may approve or reject a refund request. A refund request cannot be for more than the order's amount.

ticket.description: The ticket, as {"id": "<its id>"}. Look the id up first with a list tool.

order.description: The order, as {"id": "<its id>"}. Look the id up first with a list tool.

amount.description: The amount to refund, in the order's currency; it cannot be more than the order total.

reason.description: Why the refund is being requested, in a sentence.

decide_refund.description: A manager approves or rejects a refund request. Rules the app enforces: Only a manager may approve or reject a refund request. A refund request cannot be for more than the order's amount.

refund.description: The refund, as {"id": "<its id>"}. Look the id up first with a list tool.

decision.description: Either "approve" or "reject" (exactly one of those two words).

publish_article.description: A manager publishes a knowledge-base article so AI answers can use it. Rules the app enforces: Only a manager may publish a knowledge-base article; unpublished articles are not used to answer customers.

article.description: The article, as {"id": "<its id>"}. Look the id up first with a list tool.

request_human.description: Hand this conversation to a person on the team. Use it when the person asks for a human, or when you cannot help them. Ask them first (only what they have not already told you): Why do you need a person? How urgent is it? How can we reach you? Then call this with their answers.

reason.description: Why a person is needed, in a sentence.

contact.description: How the team can reach them, if they gave a way.

events.message: How many open tickets are there, and who is the customer on the oldest one?
